name: hatax-preparer-desktop
description: HA Tax Preparer: automated preparation with local AI, as an installable Windows application.
author: HATax

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run native && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run native && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win nsis
